description: Firewall device create POSTs the device id/type to the firewall's devices collection. Both languages now serve it from the proto contract, so every local validation message is one sentence. type is a required enum, so an absent one and an unknown one both answer the one-of sentence.

cases.name: rejects a non-positive firewall_id once confirmed
cases.expect_error: firewall_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: rejects a non-positive device id once confirmed
cases.expect_error: id must be a positive integer

cases.name: rejects an absent device type once confirmed
cases.expect_error: type must be one of: linode, nodebalancer, linode_interface

side_effects: The linode 10 will be attached to firewall 5.

cases.name: assigns a device to a firewall
requires confirm
cases.expect_error: This assigns a device to a Cloud Firewall. Set confirm=true to proceed.

cases.name: rejects an invalid device type (proto FirewallDeviceType enum)
cases.expect_error: type must be one of: linode, nodebalancer, linode_interface
